ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line AB $ \parallel $ CD $ \parallel $ EF. If AC = 3 and CE = 4, what is the value of $\frac{BD}{BF}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\because$ AB $\parallel$ CD $\parallel$ EF\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{BD}{BF}=\frac{AC}{AE}$\\
$\because$ AC=3, CE=4\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{BD}{BF}=\boxed{\frac{3}{7}}$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, there are three horizontal straight lines, labeled AB, CD, and EF from top to bottom respectively, and they are parallel to each other; two slanted lines pass through these three parallel lines as transversals. Reasoning: By the parallel-lines intercept proportionality theorem, the corresponding segments obtained when three parallel lines cut two transversals are proportional. BD on the right corresponds to AC on the left, and BF on the right corresponds to AE on the left, so BD/BF = AC/AE. Also AE = AC + CE = 3 + 4 = 7, therefore BD/BF = 3/7.

method.method_draft: Describe the image first: the figure has three horizontal parallel lines AB, CD, and EF, cut by two slanted transversals; A, C, E lie on the left transversal from top to bottom, and B, D, F lie on the right transversal from top to bottom. From the text, read AB ∥ CD ∥ EF, AC = 3, CE = 4, and the target ratio BD/BF.
